spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पुच्छति)
To err, to be careless or inattentive.

mn. (-च्छः-च्छं)
1 A tail, the tail, the hinder part.
2 A horse's tail.
3 The tail of the peacock.
4 Any hairy tail.
E.
पुच्छ to be careless, क aff.

n. (-टिः)
Snapping or cracking the fingers.

mfn. (-च्छी-च्छिनी-च्छि)
Having a tail.
m. (-च्छी)
A cock.
E.
पुच्छ a tail, and इनि aff.
